insurer: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.

room_rent.display: Single AC (₹5L–15L SI); Deluxe AC (₹25L–1Cr SI)
room_rent.note: SI ₹5L/10L/15L: Single AC room; SI ₹25L/50L/75L/1Cr: Deluxe AC room. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room chosen.

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges covered; no separate sub-limit stated in policy wording.

copayment.display: 10% if Zone II insured treats in Zone I
copayment.note: Zone I insured: no co-pay. Zone II insured taking treatment in Zone I cities: 10% co-pay. No co-pay for accidents or sub-limited treatments.

sub_limits.display: Cataract, modern treatments, congenital external, mental illness, ARMD, genetic disorders capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹50k–₹1.5L per eye by SI band; modern treatments: procedure-wise caps; congenital external: 10% of avg SI; mental illness/genetic/ARMD/puberty: 20–25% of SI; hazardous sports: 10% of SI up to ₹3L; artificial life maintenance: 25% SI/15 days.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 24 months of continuous coverage. No optional reduction mentioned.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Most specific diseases (hernia, cataract, stones, etc.) have 12-month wait; joint replacement, osteoarthritis, mental illness (F01-F29/F60-F79), ARMD, genetic disorders, congenital external: 24 months. Diabetes/hypertension/cardiac: 90 days.

maternity.note: Inbuilt only in Platinum plan; limit ₹25,000–₹50,000 (single baby) by SI band; max 2 claims lifetime; enhanced limit available as optional add-on at extra premium.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% (25%/yr); Guaranteed CB in Gold/Platinum
cumulative_bonus.note: 25% per claim-free year, max 100%. On claim, CB reduces at same rate. Gold/Platinum: Guaranteed CB — no reduction on claim. Option to take premium discount instead of CB.

restoration.display: Once/yr, 100% (unrelated only) — Base; Twice/yr in Gold/Platinum
restoration.note: Base plan: reinstatement once per policy period for unrelated illness/injury only, after full SI exhaustion. Gold/Platinum: double reinstatement (twice per policy period) for unrelated conditions. Not available for modern treatments (3.12). Individual SI basis only.

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (280+ listed in Annexure I)
day_care.note: Extensive list of 280 day-care procedures in Annexure I covered.

domiciliary.note: Clause 4.4.17 explicitly excludes domiciliary hospitalisation expenses.

ayush.note: Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy covered up to 100% of SI per policy year.

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered (excluding cost of organ and pre/post-hosp) within available SI.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance: ₹5,000 (₹5L–15L SI) to ₹20,000 (₹1Cr SI). Air ambulance covered under Gold/Platinum: ₹50,000–₹2,00,000 by SI band.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments covered (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, etc.) with procedure-specific and SI-band-based sub-limits per policy period.

consumables.note: Consumables (gloves, etc.) are in List I (not payable) or subsumed into room/procedure charges per Annexure II. No rider available.

global_cover.note: Clause 4.4.27 and 5.18 explicitly restrict coverage to India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim/policy contestable except on grounds of fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly instalment mode. Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies with term ≥1 year; not on renewals or porting.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; credit for PED waiting, specific waiting, moratorium transferable.

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary hospitalisation, treatment outside India, acupressure/acupuncture, OPD procedures, vaccination, RFQMR/ECP/EECP/hyperbaric O2

optional_riders.display: Enhanced maternity limit (Platinum add-on); Gold plan adds PA benefit, critical care lump sum, air ambulance, guaranteed CB, double reinstatement
